label: Restaurant
feature: Local business details in Google Search and Maps; Google reads the menu's URL (menu) and the cuisine (servesCuisine)
mistakes: LocalBusiness or Organization instead of a food type: menu, servesCuisine and acceptsReservations are defined only for food establishments.
A relative menu link: Google wants the full URL of the menu.
aggregateRating or review on your own business: Google uses them only on sites that collect reviews of other businesses.

feature: Local business details in Google Search and Maps; Google reads the menu's URL (menu) and the cuisine (servesCuisine)

aggregateRating or review on your own business: Google uses them only on sites that collect reviews of other businesses.

label: Bakery
feature: Local business details in Google Search and Maps
mistakes: Store or LocalBusiness for a bakery: Bakery is a food establishment, which gives it menu and opening hours fields.

label: Dentist
feature: Local business details in Google Search and Maps
mistakes: MedicalOrganization alone: it isn't a place, so opening hours and geo don't belong on it; Dentist is both a medical organization and a local business.
aggregateRating or review on your own business: Google uses them only on sites that collect reviews of other businesses.

label: Doctor's practice
feature: Local business details in Google Search and Maps
mistakes: MedicalOrganization alone: it isn't a place, so opening hours and geo don't belong on it; Physician is both a medical organization and a local business.
PhysiciansOffice ("A doctor's office or clinic" on schema.org) is a more specific choice for a practice.

label: Medical clinic
feature: Local business details in Google Search and Maps
mistakes: MedicalClinic for a dental practice or a doctor's surgery: Dentist and Physician say more.
MedicalOrganization alone: it isn't a place, so opening hours and geo don't belong on it.

label: Hospital
feature: Local business details in Google Search and Maps
mistakes: One node with every department's hours and phone: Google's local business markup reads each department as its own nested node.

label: Pharmacy
feature: Local business details in Google Search and Maps
mistakes: A pharmacy inside a shop marked as a separate business: Google's local business doc puts it in the shop's department, named like "gMart Pharmacy".

label: Optician
feature: Local business details in Google Search and Maps
mistakes: MedicalClinic or Store for an optician: Optician is its own type.

label: Lawyer or law firm
feature: Local business details in Google Search and Maps
mistakes: Attorney: schema.org deprecated it ("LegalService is more inclusive and less ambiguous").
aggregateRating or review on your own business: Google uses them only on sites that collect reviews of other businesses.

label: Estate agent
feature: Local business details in Google Search and Maps
mistakes: Listings marked up as Product with an Offer, which asks for shopping fields: schema.org has RealEstateListing for a listing page.

label: Car dealer
feature: Local business details in Google Search and Maps, with sales, service and parts as departments
mistakes: One set of opening hours for sales, service and parts: give each its own department node with its own hours and phone.
Vehicle listing markup: Google phased that rich result out in June 2025.

label: Hotel
feature: Local business details in Google Search and Maps
mistakes: starRating from guest reviews: schema.org defines it as "an official rating for a lodging business", from national associations or standards bodies.
aggregateRating or review on your own business: Google uses them only on sites that collect reviews of other businesses.

label: Software or online tool
feature: Software app rich result (needs name, offers.price and a real aggregateRating or review); the company itself stays an Organization
mistakes: No rating or review: Google's Software app result needs one, and it must be real.
The company's rating attached to the app: ratings in the app's markup must be about the app (SCHEMA-04).
An applicationCategory Google doesn't list: use one of its values, such as BusinessApplication or SecurityApplication.

mistakes: EducationalOrganization or Organization for a school: School says what it is.

label: News publisher or magazine
feature: Article results for its stories (Article, NewsArticle or BlogPosting on each story)
mistakes: Organization instead of NewsMediaOrganization: it hides what the site is, and masthead is defined only for news media organizations.
Article markup without author and dates: Google recommends author, datePublished and dateModified.
